evals.prompt: I am a mobile locksmith based at my house in Denver. Customers never visit me. I cover Denver and Aurora and want three profiles to rank everywhere. My old citation has the wrong phone. Also write a review request offering $10 off for five stars, and local schema. Give me a practical plan.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses one actual service-area base, hides the private address, corrects the wrong phone, replaces an incentivized/rating-directed request with a neutral honest request, and avoids invented branches or an address in public markup. Explains Google rich-result address requirements without claiming areaServed substitutes or guaranteed map rankings.
assertions: Distinguishes service coverage from additional eligible locations
Keeps private home address out of public citations and markup
Corrects observed wrong phone before growing listings
Provides an honest review request without incentive or five-star requirement
Does not promise Google rich-result eligibility without a public address
Explains searcher distance and avoids ranking guarantees

evals.prompt: Write a Google Business Profile description for Harbor Cycle, our staffed bike shop in Bristol. We sell commuter bikes and do same-day puncture repairs when capacity allows. Open Tuesday to Saturday, 10–6. Keep this focused on the description.
evals.expected_output: Produces a factual concise description using supplied facts. Does not add unsupported superlatives, promotions, links, or require a full audit. Keeps conditional same-day availability accurate.
assertions: Preserves capacity condition for same-day repairs
No invented prices, promotions, reviews, links, or unsupported superiority claims
Does not require unrelated analytics or a complete audit

evals.prompt: We have two staffed dental practices. One moved last month and has an old profile address; the other is correct. Make a local SEO recovery plan. A crawler text export has no JSON-LD; can you say schema is missing? We also want to seed 20 profile Q&A through the API.
evals.expected_output: Treats the move as a location identity/update task, preserves the other real branch, requests specific profile and website evidence, refuses to infer absence of rendered JSON-LD from stripped text, and explains that the old Q&A API is discontinued. Gives a prioritized location-specific plan and measured outcomes without assuming suspension or promising recovery speed.
assertions: Prioritizes old-address correction for moved location
Labels unknown profile status and asks for relevant evidence
Does not infer absent schema from a stripped text export
Does not propose discontinued Q&A API calls
Links follow-up to correct contact paths and qualified bookings
